newsitem.title: JAPAN: SESC suspects Nomura compensated client for losses.
newsitem.headline: SESC suspects Nomura compensated client for losses.

text.p: A complaint filed with prosecutors by Japan's Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) on Tuesday alleges that Nomura Securities Co Ltd and former Nomura executives compensated a client for investment losses, government sources said.
They said that the complaint alleges that the compensation payments totalled 49.7 million yen.
The sources said the securities watchdog would start drawing up its recommendations for penalties against Japan's top brokerage now.
However, they said it was too early to say how long it would takes the SESC to present the proposals to the Finance Ministry.
